summary: NewHydrogen, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 11, 2026, disclosing an Equity Financing Agreement and Registration Rights Agreement dated September 8, 2026 with GHS Investments, LLC, establishing a $3,000,000 committed equity facility (a US equivalent of a standby equity subscription line). Puts become available only upon Form S-1 effectiveness, capped at 200% of trailing ten-day dollar volume and 4.99% beneficial ownership, priced at 92.5% of the lowest traded price over the prior ten sessions, with $10,000-$1,000,000 put sizes and 980,713 commitment shares issued. This is an ordinary shelf-style financing, not a special situation; watch dilution and registration timing.
